body.statement: For every distribution \(P\) on \(\mathbb N_0^V\) with \(p_0>0\), \(T_k((p_x)_{x\in I_4})=c_k\) for \(1\le|k|\le4\), and \(\Pr_P\{t_4(P)\in C_n\}\ge1-\eta\). The inequality is finite-sample and uniform over \(\mathcal M_d^\circ\), without a lower bound on \(p_0\).
body.justification: The finite rational log-series identity converts bounded cell concentration into honest simultaneous coefficient coverage.
body.gap: Xiang et al. use bootstrap rank tests and Nakamura and Perez-Abreu study empirical-PGF inference, but neither constructs this denominator-safe finite coefficient region.
body.consumer: The coefficient region is the input for graph-set inference in sparse football and shopping count tables.
